# Ask your AI

> Ask your AI is a service in preparation, created by Freedom.AI Lab. The owner of a website pastes its address; an agent reads the site and builds a fact sheet that ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity can read, a box and a contact popup for the site, and an install guide.

## Facts

- [Fact sheet](ask-your-ai.md): what the service does, how it works, what is in the kit, principles, price and what is not published.
- [Home page](index.html): the intended journey, with simulated data.

## Not published

- Launch date, the price of the hosted plan, the number of sites built, any customer list, refund terms, terms of use and privacy policy.
